leaves.name: neronDescentSH
leaves.doc: Bosch-Lutkebohmert-Raynaud, Neron models (1990): descent of Neron models from the strict henselization (a smooth K-group scheme of finite type has a Neron model over the DVR R if and only if its base change to K^sh has one over R^sh; 7.2 Thm 1 / 6.5, locator UNVERIFIED), the 'if' direction for abelian varieties, R^sh pinned by IsSHSep as in GapSHPair.NeronBaseChangeStrictHenselization. Existence over henselian DVRs is proved (vendored FLT development, NeronFLT.exists_neron_of_henselian).
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED (BLR 7.2 Thm 1 / 6.5: Neron models descend from R^sh to R); R^sh pinned by IsSHSep (EGA IV 18.8.8 reading, as GapSHPair)
leaves.source: BLR 7.2 Thm 1 / 6.5 (descent from the strict henselization)
